_readme: Narration delivery for the pilot (generate_story_audio.py). Settled by ear 2026-08: the plain voice at 128k mp3 with no speed adjustment and no emotion sounded clean, while 96k / a speed adjustment / the emotion parameter (in some combination) made it nasal and watery — so those stay off until re-tested one at a time with --diagnose. Sentence pauses at 250ms were picked from --pause-test. Resolution order for every setting is age_bands > tellers > top level, so a band can override pace or even voice while tellers still choose who is telling. Every band the library may contain has an entry, including 3-4 and 11-12 which have no stories yet — otherwise a new band would silently inherit the 9-10 pacing. Younger bands get longer pauses rather than slower speech, because pauses cost nothing in audio quality and a speed adjustment is exactly what we suspect of the artifacts — revisit with `--diagnose` at 128k before adding speed back. Paragraph and segment gaps are NOT here: they're player-side (BujuPilot.narration in pilot/js/stories.js) and are themselves scaled per age band, so they retune without regenerating. Anything in this file is baked into the mp3s: change it and regenerate with --force.
